public_route_rule: Existing client-visible routes remain stable; service placement is an internal deployment concern.
cross_context_data_rule: Use stable IDs and signed events across contexts; do not introduce cross-context database foreign keys or direct database access.

event_service_id.activation_gate: A backwards-compatible migration, event-signature compatibility fixtures, and an independently hosted service or replica pilot must exist before service_id becomes emitted runtime data.
event_service_id.compatibility_rule: Unknown service IDs are retained as signed event metadata but are not interpreted as authorization or routing instructions.

required: independent hosting and named operational owner
signed event replay and compatibility evidence
rollback plan and live observation window
